ConnectionStrings._comment_PrivilegedConnection: RLS increment 2b/3. BLANK (the committed default) = NON-BREAKING: the ConnectionRoutingInterceptor always uses DefaultConnection and Hangfire storage stays on DefaultConnection, so behaviour is identical to today. The increment-3 FLIP is to (1) run Persistence/Rls/roles.sql on the target DB to create hrm_app (NOBYPASSRLS) + hrm_owner (BYPASSRLS), (2) point DefaultConnection at hrm_app and set PrivilegedConnection to the hrm_owner conn string, and (3) set Rls:Enabled=true. Then the interceptor routes resolved-non-system tenant requests to hrm_app (RLS enforced) and startup/system/unresolved/job paths + Hangfire schema DDL to hrm_owner. DEV ENFORCEMENT (decision): appsettings.Development.json will later repoint DefaultConnection->hrm_app + PrivilegedConnection->hrm_owner after roles.sql is run on hris_dev_db (the default 'developer' role is a superuser and superusers always bypass RLS, so dev proves nothing until repointed). Do NOT set these now.

Entra._comment: CR-AUTH-001 Enterprise SSO (Microsoft Entra/O365). Enabled=false OR blank ClientId/ClientSecret/RedirectUri → SSO is OFF (login button reports 'not configured'). Put ClientSecret in user-secrets, NOT here: dotnet user-secrets set "Authentication:Entra:ClientSecret" "<secret>". TenantAllowList (the US-AUTH-013 isolation guard) is dev-only config and lives in appsettings.Development.json.

Smtp._comment: US-NTF-006 real email delivery. Non-secret here; Smtp:Username + Smtp:Password live in user-secrets (never commit credentials). BLANK Host => log-only stub (LogOnlyEmailSender), the safe default that sends nothing. Set Host (via user-secrets/appsettings.Development.json) to enable the MailKit SmtpEmailSender — e.g. Gmail Host=smtp.gmail.com Port=587 (app password required), or smtp4dev Host=localhost Port=2525 UseStartTls=false. FromAddress defaults to Username when omitted.

SecondLevelCache._comment: P3 EF second-level (query-result) cache (EFCoreSecondLevelCacheInterceptor). Transparent caching of SELECTs whose tables are ALL in CachedTables, with auto-invalidation on SaveChanges. Redis-backed when ConnectionStrings:Redis is set, in-memory otherwise (never a hard dependency; a Redis outage degrades to a DB read). Cache keys are tenant-prefixed (t:{tenantId}: / sys: / none:) so results never cross tenants. CachedTables MUST be slow-changing, read-heavy REFERENCE tables only — NEVER role/permission tables (owned by the permission cache) or volatile/transactional tables (attendance, leave requests, payroll runs, notifications, audit). TtlMinutes: absolute expiry for reference data (~30-60 min). Remove a table here to stop caching it; leave CachedTables empty to fall back to the built-in default whitelist.

OpenTelemetry._comment: P3 observability (docs/observability-otel-grafana-plan.md). OtlpEndpoint is the OTLP/gRPC address of the OTel Collector (e.g. http://localhost:4317 or http://otel-collector:4317 in compose). BLANK (the default) => Console exporter only, NO external dependency: the app starts and runs normally with no collector. Also honoured via the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT env var. Set OtlpEndpoint (via appsettings.Development.json / env) to ship traces+metrics to the Collector.
